title: UE01/BLC-DEMO-001 CommonUryu Ishida BLEACH Union Arena Trading Card Game TCG CCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This UE01/BLC-DEMO-001 CommonUryu Ishida BLEACH Union Arena Trading Card Game TCG CCG is a must-have for fans of the popular anime series. The card features Uryu Ishida, a multi-colored character, and is made of high-quality paper material. It is a standard-sized card and is suitable for players aged 8 years and above.

The card is from the 2023 Union Arena game and is a Thousand-Year Blood War card type. It is a rare find and is not autographed. The card is in Japanese language and manufactured by Bandai in Japan. This collectible card game is perfect for those who love to collect and play with their favorite characters.
